player_0.content: New plan: I got stuck in a loop between Dining room and Balcony, repeatedly going north and then south, and then back to Dining room. What is worse, after going back and forth for some time, I decided to keep going in the same direction without checking if I had already visited the current room. Next time, I will keep track of the rooms I have visited and avoid revisiting them. I will also try to explore new directions and rooms more systematically, for example, by going east from Dining room and then north from Balcony. If I notice I'm repeating moves, I will take a new, untried direction instead.
